label.text:
Pick a script on the left or create a new one. The path at the top can be edited to save a copy, and it must end in .lua.

Check finds syntax errors and jumps to the line. Run starts the script in a sandbox, calls onCreate once and onUpdate every frame, and shows what it prints in the console. Song callbacks only work inside a song.

The editor completes Lua API names while you type three letters, and offers snippets such as onBeatHit or for. Tab accepts.

The Lua Bot on the right writes code for you. Describe what you want in English or Portuguese, for example: shake the camera every 4 beats. Insert merges the code into the callbacks your script already has, Replace starts from the generated code and Copy puts it on the clipboard. Ask it to change the last answer (change the duration to 2 seconds) or press Review script and it looks for mistakes such as unknown functions, misspelled callbacks and missing end keywords.

item.action: Show or hide the Lua Bot
